name: task-adapter-github-projects
description: Dual-host executable GitHub Projects adapter for backend-neutral task query, preflight, and approval-bound apply.

interface.shortDescription: Run the reviewed GitHub Projects task adapter.
interface.longDescription: Defines the credential-free GitHub Projects adapter contract and host configuration. Hermes registers executable query, preflight, and apply tools; host policy keeps raw MCP tools adapter-only and write tools task-management-only.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the GitHub Projects task-adapter configuration and runtime boundary.
